title: 練習本 B｜精選文法題

questions.question: Jim: Do you know Mary Smith and her brother John? Helen: No, I don't know ______.
questions.explanation: Mary 和 John 是兩個人，受格代名詞用複數 them。

questions.question: This restaurant is full. Let's ______ to Rose Garden across the street.
questions.explanation: Let's 後面接原形動詞。

questions.question: Let's not sit here. It's ______ noisy. We should go to a quieter place to talk.
questions.explanation: too + 形容詞 = 太…（程度過度），此處表噪音太大。

questions.question: ______ this letter to Fred when you see him this afternoon. It's about his new job.
questions.explanation: 肯定祈使句直接用原形動詞開頭。

questions.question: Pete: Where can I buy some sugar? Sarah: There ______ a small store near the park.
questions.explanation: There is/are 表存在；store 是單數，用 There is。

questions.question: The game is for students ______ seven and ten years old.
questions.explanation: between A and B 表「在 A 與 B 之間」，用於年齡範圍。

questions.question: The apartment is big enough for me, ______ it is far from my office. I will look for another one.
questions.explanation: 前後語意相反（夠大 vs 太遠），用 but 表轉折。

questions.question: The students next to you are from the USA, but the student near the desk ______.
questions.explanation: but 表對比，近桌的學生（單數）不是來自美國，用 isn't。

questions.question: Amanda: ______ is Linda? Hank: I don't know. Maybe at Jessica's house. They have to hand in their science report the day after tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 回答地點（at Jessica's house），疑問詞用 Where。

questions.question: Look! The school bus ______. Let's run, or we may not catch it.
questions.explanation: Look! 暗示動作正在發生，用現在進行式 is leaving。

questions.question: Amy: The elephant, Dumbo, can do many things. It can fly and draw. ______ can he be so smart? Bill: A good question, but I don't know, either.
questions.explanation: 問「怎麼會這麼聰明」，程度副詞用 How。

questions.question: Betty: ______ is the weather like in Pingtung? Bob: It's sunny. And it's very hot, too.
questions.explanation: What is the weather like? 是問天氣的固定句型。

questions.question: Jerry has to wash the fans this afternoon, but Tina ______. She's going to water the flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: 與 has to 呼應，否定用 doesn't（have to），省略後半保持對比。

questions.question: Son: Mom, I'm home. Mom: Go wash your hands first. Son: Don't worry, Mom. I ______ do.
questions.explanation: 孩子表示「我每次都會洗手」，習慣性動作用 always。

questions.question: Brian: Do your brothers and sister like parties? Eric: My sister, Grace, likes parties, but my brothers ______.
questions.explanation: brothers 是複數，否定助動詞用 don't。

questions.question: Ted: It's 6:40 p.m. The movie starts at 7:30 p.m. What can we do to kill time? Nancy: We can go shopping ______ take a walk in the park. Which do you like?
questions.explanation: 提供兩個選項請對方選一，用 or（或）。

questions.question: Sam: How often do you walk your dog? Jean: I never do that. But my mom ______ it every day.
questions.explanation: 主詞 my mom 是第三人稱單數，習慣性動作現在式加 s → walks。

questions.question: Martin doesn't read very much. He doesn't have ______ books.
questions.explanation: books 是可數名詞複數，否定句用 many。

questions.question: Jim: Who's that tall woman over there? Ted: I don't know ______.
questions.explanation: tall woman 是女性單數，受格代名詞用 her。

questions.question: Frank: ______ do you and Eric eat out? Sherry: Five days a week. I cook on weekends.
questions.explanation: 回答 Five days a week（頻率），疑問詞用 How often。

questions.question: Gary: How can you do this to me? Aren't ______ friends? John: Cool down, Gary. You're my best friend.
questions.explanation: Aren't we friends? 主詞位置用主格代名詞 we。

questions.question: Sherry: Do you usually do your homework before dinner? Tom: No, I don't, but my sister Carrie ______.
questions.explanation: 與前面 do 呼應，Carrie 是第三人稱單數，肯定替代用 does。

questions.question: Jessica took a trip to the beautiful island and stayed there for ______ week, from July 2 to July 7.
questions.explanation: July 2–7 約五天，差一點才是一週，用 almost（將近）。

questions.question: Jenny ______ to school by bus or in her father's car every morning. She is never late for school.
questions.explanation: every morning 表習慣性動作，第三人稱單數現在式 goes。

questions.question: River Town is a great place for summer vacation. It is not so hot, and ______ little rain. You can put it on your trip list.
questions.explanation: 表示「雨量少」用 there is little rain，存在句型 There is/are。

questions.question: I am not cold at all. I am wearing a heavy sweater ______ my jacket.
questions.explanation: 毛衣穿在外套底下，介系詞用 under。

questions.question: Joe: What do you think of Judy's new house? Amelia: It's a nice house, ______ it has only one bathroom. It's not convenient for a family of four.
questions.explanation: 前後語意轉折（房子不錯 vs 只有一間浴室），用 but。

questions.question: Wendy: Hello. This is Wendy Wu. Is Linda in? May I speak to her? Tom: Yes, she is. But she's busy at the moment. ______ dinner.
questions.explanation: at the moment 表示此刻正在進行，用現在進行式 She's cooking。

questions.question: Two Parties, one of Kevin Pitt's newest books, ______ the story of a man with two interesting jobs at a time.
questions.explanation: 主詞是書名 Two Parties（視為單數），現在式用 tells。

questions.question: Gary: Do we have ice cream in the refrigerator? Jane: Yes, but not ______.
questions.explanation: ice cream 是不可數名詞，量詞用 much；否定句 not much = 沒有很多。

questions.question: Mom: Luke, don't stay up too late. It's 12:00! Luke: But I have a big test tomorrow. Mom: ______ enough sleep, and you can do better.
questions.explanation: 命令句 + and = 結果句型：Get... and you can...，原形動詞開頭。

questions.question: Andy: Wow, a pretty kite. ______ did it take you to make it? John: Two days. And my dad helped me with it.
questions.explanation: 回答 Two days（時間長度），用 How long。

questions.question: Jason ______ thinking about Alice. He missed her so much. They were so far away from each other.
questions.explanation: keep + V-ing 表「一直持續做某事」，kept thinking = 一直想著。

questions.question: ______ is wrong for you to take Peter's toys without asking first, Jenny. You should say sorry to your brother.
questions.explanation: It is + 形容詞 + for sb + to V，it 為虛主詞。

questions.question: Emily was sad because her parents did not allow her ______ to her best friend's party in another town.
questions.explanation: allow sb to V 為固定句型，用不定詞 to go。

questions.question: Fifteen years after Ryan moved to the USA, he ______ back to Taiwan last week.
questions.explanation: last week 是明確過去時間點，用過去簡單式 came。

questions.question: Karen is a booklover. She ______ one to two hours reading before going to work every morning.
questions.explanation: spend + 時間 + V-ing 表「花時間做某事」，主詞是人。

questions.question: Tom works at a factory. After work, he sells toys at a night market ______ he wants to buy a house for his family.
questions.explanation: 說明賣玩具的原因（想買房），用 because。

questions.question: Ken: I'm working in a bookstore. Anna: Really? You ______ in a bookstore last time I saw you. Ken: I changed jobs two weeks ago.
questions.explanation: last time I saw you 是過去情境，描述當時持續狀態用過去進行式 weren't working。

questions.question: Reading bedtime stories to his two kids ______ Steve a lot of pleasure.
questions.explanation: 動名詞片語作主詞視為單數，現在式動詞用 gives。

questions.question: David: Did you see Jack this afternoon? Lisa: No, I didn't. He wasn't in the office. But ______ in front of the museum at 8 p.m. You can go with me. David: OK.
questions.explanation: Lisa 提議今晚 8 點碰面（未來計畫），用 be going to。

questions.question: Clerk: How about this blue dress? Jennifer: Well, I don't like this one. Please show me ______.
questions.explanation: 不特定的「另一件（衣服）」用 another。

questions.question: No one ______ David move out. He himself decided to do it.
questions.explanation: make sb + 原形動詞 = 強迫某人做…，made David move out。

questions.question: Bob finished the math test ______ than Lisa did, but he got more questions wrong than she did.
questions.explanation: Bob 完成得比 Lisa 快（but 後說出更多錯），速度比較用 more quickly。

questions.question: If you don't stand up for yourself, no one else ______. It's all up to you.
questions.explanation: if 子句用現在式，主句談未來結果用 will。

questions.question: Carol doesn't like Mark because he only cares about ______. He seldom thinks for other people.
questions.explanation: Mark 只關心自己，反身代名詞 himself 與主詞一致。

questions.question: I know Mr. Peterson well. ______ he may look serious, he is, in fact, a kind and sweet person.
questions.explanation: 「雖然他看起來嚴肅，但其實親切」，讓步連接詞 though（雖然）。

questions.question: Greg: Are we going to buy the blue sofa or the green one? Sandra: The green one. It's ______ comfortable, but it'll save us some money.
questions.explanation: 選綠色是因為省錢，雖然「比較不舒適」，用 less + 形容詞。

questions.question: When the police arrived at the bank in a hurry, they saw a man with a knife ______ out of the door. Finally, they caught the man who tried to hurt people.
questions.explanation: see + 受詞 + V-ing = 看見某人正在做…，此處用 running。

questions.question: Robert: Is the ruler on the sofa yours? Carol: No, it's not ______. Ask Lora. It should be hers.
questions.explanation: it's not mine（不是我的），所有格代名詞 mine 作補語。

questions.question: This yellow umbrella is not Ann's. ______ is red.
questions.explanation: 指「她的（傘）」，所有格代名詞 Hers（= her umbrella）作主詞。

questions.question: When Mr. Brown was 80 years old, he was ______, and he did not hear well, either.
questions.explanation: be 動詞後接形容詞作補語；與年輕時比較用比較級 slower。

questions.question: ______ to work today? If so, can I ride in your car to City Library? It's on your way to work.
questions.explanation: 詢問今天是否打算開車去上班，用 be going to 表未來計畫。

questions.question: If you'd like to catch the first train, ______ a taxi will be better.
questions.explanation: 動名詞 taking a taxi 作主詞，全句意為「搭計程車會比較好」。

questions.question: Ken: What happened ______ us, Helen? Aren't we good friends? Why are you so cold to me? Helen: You should know it.
questions.explanation: happen between... = 發生在兩者之間，用 between。

questions.question: Henry is a great fan of Taylor Swift. He won't miss any chance to see her sing at a music festival ______ he has the time.
questions.explanation: 「只要有時間就不會錯過」，條件連接詞 if（如果）。

questions.question: Jerry won't be here today. When he ______ tomorrow, please give him this box and letter.
questions.explanation: when 引導時間子句，不用 will，以現在簡單式代替未來式 → comes。

questions.question: It usually ______ me about half an hour to get to work, but sometimes longer.
questions.explanation: It takes sb + 時間 + to V，表花某人多少時間，固定句型。

questions.question: If John wants to get to the top of the mountain, he must ______ the road along the river.
questions.explanation: must 是情態助動詞，後接原形動詞 take。

questions.question: Of all the stories in this book, I like the one about animals ______. It is not as interesting as the others.
questions.explanation: Of all...（三者以上最高級），它最不有趣，用 the least。

questions.question: Bob: Do you know Emily Anderson? Jenny: Yes, I do. I met her at a party several years ago. She ______ at an art museum at that time.
questions.explanation: at that time（當時）描述過去那個時間點持續進行的狀態，用過去進行式。

questions.question: Frank: My friend bought a sweater at this store last week. Here's a picture of it. Do you still have one like ______? Clerk: Yes, there are still two in the store.
questions.explanation: 指照片中的「這件（毛衣）」，用指示代名詞 this。

questions.question: The bank is only half a mile from here. It won't ______ too much time to get there.
questions.explanation: It takes（時間）固定句型的否定形，won't take too much time。

questions.question: Rick: It's Sunday. Don't you play tennis today? Jim: No, I ______ play tennis on Sunday. I play it on Wednesday and Saturday.
questions.explanation: Jim 只在週三和週六打，所以週日從不打，用 never。

questions.question: After Jason handed Mary a birthday gift, he ______ for an important meeting right away.
questions.explanation: After... handed（過去式），主句描述後續動作也用過去式 headed。

questions.question: Late at night, Nick heard the doorbell ______, so he got up to answer it.
questions.explanation: hear + 受詞 + 原形動詞，表感知完整動作 → heard the doorbell ring。

questions.question: Harry and I live in the same apartment. I live on the 16th floor, and he lives ______ me on the 22nd floor.
questions.explanation: 22 樓高於 16 樓，在我「上面」，用 above。

questions.question: This dress is pretty, ______ it does look good on you. It's the last one in the store. You should buy it.
questions.explanation: 兩個正面評價並列（漂亮 + 好看），用 and 連接。

questions.question: When Eric talked to me this morning, he didn't look me in the eyes. Right then and there, I thought he ______ something from me.
questions.explanation: 在過去時間點 thought，描述當時持續的行為，從句用過去進行式 was hiding。

questions.question: Judy: Did Tina buy any cheese in the supermarket this afternoon? Sam: No, she didn't, but she bought ______ oil.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表「一些（不可數）」用 some。

questions.question: Painting and painting well ______ quite different. To paint well, you need to practice often.
questions.explanation: 兩個並列動名詞片語（Painting 和 painting well）作主詞，視為複數，用 are。

questions.question: Ken taught three-year-old Emma and Tony to button the large front buttons of their coat ______. After some practice, they learned how to do it.
questions.explanation: 「靠自己」扣扣子，反身代名詞 themselves 表「自己完成」。

questions.question: Andy: When you get to Lake Town, give me a call. Lucy: OK. I ______.
questions.explanation: 承諾未來會打電話，用 will（I will [give you a call]）。

questions.question: Stella ______ chicken in the kitchen. She is not talking on the telephone.
questions.explanation: 現在正在廚房煮雞肉（進行中），用現在進行式 is cooking。

questions.question: Ivy and Amy have found a job in the big city, and so ______ George. They are going to start their new job in middle August.
questions.explanation: so + 助動詞 + 主詞（倒裝）表「也是」；George 是單數，與 have found 對應用 has。

questions.question: Harry and five of his friends had dinner at a restaurant last weekend. Two of them ordered steak, and ______ ordered pizza.
questions.explanation: 六人中兩人點牛排，「其餘所有人（特定）」用 the others。

questions.question: Richard: Do you know ______ Jack is going to close down his business? Elsa: Maybe it's because of his poor health.
questions.explanation: Elsa 回答原因（poor health），問的是「為什麼」，用 why。

questions.question: Jerry is much ______ than I remember him. He must have lost at least 20 pounds.
questions.explanation: 掉了至少 20 磅，人變瘦了，比較級 slimmer（更苗條）。

questions.question: Anna ______ a bookstore in Ilan. She has been in this business since she was 30 years old.
questions.explanation: 目前經營書店是現在的事實，用現在簡單式 runs（第三人稱單數）。

questions.question: ______ louder when you talk to these kids. They have hearing problems.
questions.explanation: 祈使句以原形動詞開頭，Speak louder = 說大聲一點。

questions.question: After Jason hit the ball, it flew ______ the air and landed in his neighbor's garden.
questions.explanation: 球穿越空中，介系詞用 through（穿過）。

questions.question: Jerry: Would you like to go to the soccer game with me this afternoon? Emma: I'd like to, ______ I can't. I have to finish this report today.
questions.explanation: 「想去，但不能去」，前後轉折用 but。

questions.question: It ______ heavily this afternoon when Belinda rode her bike home, and she got all wet.
questions.explanation: this afternoon 她騎車回家時（過去持續的背景），用過去進行式 was raining。

questions.question: Ken doesn't know Anna well. In fact, he knows ______ about her. He has no idea where she comes from or what she does.
questions.explanation: 「知道很少」修飾不可數概念用 little（few 修飾可數）。

questions.question: It has not rained for weeks. The weather report says that there may ______ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 存在句型 there be：there may be rain = 可能有雨。

questions.question: Lucas is thinking of moving to Dolphin Island and ______ his own business. Though he is not quite sure of his dream, he will give it a try.
questions.explanation: think of + V-ing，並列結構 moving... and starting，皆用動名詞。

questions.question: Most of the files ______. I'll finish the others this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 大多數檔案「已被上傳完畢」，現在完成式被動 have been uploaded。

questions.question: If you buy the used car, you ______ sorry. Don't you hear people say buying a used car is buying someone else's problems?
questions.explanation: 第一條件句：if + 現在式，主句用 will，will be sorry。

questions.question: Jane learned from the news ______ a big typhoon is going to hit Taiwan in two days. So she has to prepare some food.
questions.explanation: learn + that 子句（名詞子句），that 引導事實內容。

questions.question: If Sofia feels better tomorrow, she will go camping with us, ______?
questions.explanation: 附加問句：前句肯定 will，問句用否定 won't she？

questions.question: It's late March, and I still haven't finished the painting ______. I'll have to spend more time on it.
questions.explanation: haven't + yet 表「尚未完成」，yet 用於否定句句尾。

questions.question: Mr. Anderson is happy that ______ of the students passed the difficult math test. Only three failed.
questions.explanation: 30 人中只有 3 人沒通過，大多數通過，用 most。

questions.question: Ken did not know the name of the reporter ______ him the day before.
questions.explanation: 關係子句修飾 reporter，主格關係代名詞 who + 過去式 interviewed。

questions.question: In the coffee shop, Melody sat ______ Andy, looked into his eyes, and then told him how she felt about their feelings.
questions.explanation: 面對面坐著（對視），介系詞片語 across from（在…對面）。

questions.question: Frank didn't go home ______ he finished all his work. When he got home, it was already 11:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: not... until = 直到…才…，直到完成工作才回家。

questions.question: When Richard was a teenager, he ______ in New York for five years. That's why he speaks English so well.
questions.explanation: when he was a teenager 是過去特定時間段，用過去簡單式 lived。

questions.question: Susan asked me ______ I'd like her to pick me up at the airport, and I said yes.
questions.explanation: 間接問句中「是否」用 whether（或 if）引導。

questions.question: I have no idea ______ used your cellphone without asking. Maybe you can ask John. I saw him walk past your desk just now.
questions.explanation: 名詞子句中「誰」用 who 作主詞，I have no idea who used...。

questions.question: Rick: You look happy, Amy. What's up? Amy: ______ my science test. Rick: Good for you. All your hard work paid off.
questions.explanation: 剛剛通過考試（現有結果），用現在完成式 I've passed。

questions.question: All the students who wish to join the summer program will have to hand in a 500-word report about popular music by June 21. And only five of them ______ to enter the program.
questions.explanation: 五個人「被選中」進入（被動），未來時態被動 will be chosen。

questions.question: Henry: Is Teresa Lin the woman you've been looking for? Sam: No, she is not ______ I used to work with.
questions.explanation: she is not the one I used to work with，特定人物用 the one。

questions.question: ______ hard enough, and you can finish the work in a week. Keep it up, Jerry!
questions.explanation: 命令句 + and = 結果句型：Work hard enough, and you can...。

questions.question: ______ a new sports store on the corner of Brown Street and Green Street next year, the fifth one in Rainbow Town.
questions.explanation: 表示未來「將會有」，存在句型 There will be（未來式）。

questions.question: Lily has watched her mother ______ for years, and now she is a good cook herself.
questions.explanation: watch + 受詞 + 原形動詞，感官動詞接受詞再接原形動詞。

questions.question: Tina: What's in your bag, Jerry? Jerry: A new camera. It's a gift ______ my son. Tomorrow is his 20th birthday.
questions.explanation: a gift for sb = 給某人的禮物。

questions.question: Ted: It's already 7:30 p.m. Should we start now? Alice: No. We must wait ______ Sabine comes.
questions.explanation: wait until... = 等到…才，直到 Sabine 來才開始。

questions.question: Carol took a picture of Fred while he ______. In the picture, he appeared lost in thoughts.
questions.explanation: while 引導同時發生的過去背景，用過去進行式 was not looking。

questions.question: Next week is Greg's birthday, so Tina decided to go to the department store this afternoon ______ a new guitar for him.
questions.explanation: 不定詞 to buy 表目的，去百貨公司「為了買」吉他。

questions.question: Fred doesn't ______ anyone enter his room when he is busy with writing.
questions.explanation: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞 = 讓某人做…，doesn't let = 不讓。

questions.question: During their trip to Japan in early 2020, Andrew and Lillian ______ in a five-star hotel in Tokyo for three nights, which was comfortable.
questions.explanation: in early 2020 是確定過去時間，用過去簡單式 stayed。

questions.question: Climbing to the top of the highest mountain in the world almost ______ Jason's life. It was just too dangerous.
questions.explanation: cost sb + 名詞（生命/費用），差點要了 Jason 的命：almost cost his life。

questions.question: Both of the picture books on the desk are very interesting. One is about the history of jeans, and ______ is about the highest mountain in the world.
questions.explanation: 只有兩本書，「另一本（特定）」用 the other。

questions.question: Dan: Where's Sarah? Mandy: She went out to send some letters ten minutes ago. Dan: Can she get some coffee on the way back? Mandy: I'm not sure. I ______ call and ask her.
questions.explanation: 表示等一下要去打電話（未來意圖），用 will。

questions.question: Anna: Do George and Fanny live in the UK now? Julie: Yes, they're ______ there. I'm going to visit them this summer.
questions.explanation: 他們「還在」英國，副詞 still（仍然）。

questions.question: The old movie ______ Sam, so he didn't finish it. He left the theater at about 7:30 p.m., an hour before the movie was over.
questions.explanation: 電影（主詞）嚇到了 Sam，主動過去式 scared（使驚嚇）。

questions.question: Vivien is sharing a latest report ______ studies Internet habits of junior high school students.
questions.explanation: 關係代名詞 that 引導形容詞子句修飾 report（物），that studies...。

questions.question: Tony's school is only a few blocks away from his home. He doesn't have to get up early like his classmates, and he usually goes to school ______ foot.
questions.explanation: on foot = 步行，固定片語。

questions.question: Jim: We've finished painting the walls today, ______ let's call it a day. Sara: Great! Let's go out to get something to eat.
questions.explanation: 已完成油漆（原因），所以收工（結果），用 so 表因果。

questions.question: William looks serious because he ______ the news about the strong earthquake in Taiwan. He can't take his eyes off the TV.
questions.explanation: he can't take his eyes off the TV 表示現在正在看，用現在進行式 is watching。

questions.question: Whales are large animals on Earth, and they live in the sea. There are ______ of them today than before because many have been killed for meat and oil.
questions.explanation: whales 是可數名詞，「更少」用 fewer（less 用於不可數）。

questions.question: Sandy's father told her ______ up her brother's birthday cake on her way home, but she totally forgot about it.
questions.explanation: tell sb to V 固定句型，told her to pick up...。

questions.question: Jenny: How often do you give your cat Molly a bath? Tom: I seldom do. She cleans ______ several times a day. She likes to be clean at all times.
questions.explanation: 貓（she）自己清潔自己，反身代名詞 herself。

questions.question: When Sam was taking a shower last night, the water went cold. He had to finish his shower quickly, or he ______ a cold.
questions.explanation: 與過去假設條件呼應：過去的假設結果用 would + V（would get a cold）。

questions.question: Henry ______ sixty thousand dollars for his new cellphone. It was really expensive.
questions.explanation: pay + 金額 + for + 物品，Henry 付了六萬元，用 paid。

questions.question: Jason: Is this your jacket, Zola? Zola: No, it's not. Let me take a look. Hmm, Mary has ______ like this. Jason: OK, I'll ask her.
questions.explanation: Mary 有一件像這樣的（外套），不特定單數用 one。

questions.question: Amanda loves expensive new clothes, so she buys them often. Her clothes surely ______ her a lot of money.
questions.explanation: clothes（物）是主詞，cost sb + 金錢，物品讓人「花費」。

questions.question: Lina: It's time for lunch, Mark. Mark: Please wait for 10 minutes, Mom. I ______ to Grandpa on LINE.
questions.explanation: 現在正在 LINE 上與爺爺說話，用現在進行式 am talking。

questions.question: David: Is Adam Grant the writer ______ Give and Take? Rita: Yes, he finished writing it in 2013. It's one of the best books I've ever read.
questions.explanation: 關係子句修飾 writer（人），主格關係代名詞 who + 過去式 wrote。

questions.question: Jack: How long are you going to stay at the coffee shop? Mark: Maybe ______ 5 p.m. I have to meet Jane at the train station at 5:30.
questions.explanation: stay until 5 p.m. = 待到下午五點，until 表「直到某時間點」。

questions.question: Henry is not sure ______ Emily is still living on Second Street. The last time he visited her was more than 20 years ago.
questions.explanation: 不確定「是否」，間接問句用 whether（是否）。

questions.question: During her last trip to London, Martha ______ the famous art museum twice. If she has the chance to visit the city in the future, she will surely spend more time at the museum.
questions.explanation: during her last trip 是確定過去時間，用過去簡單式 visited。

questions.question: I saw four movies last month. The movie about the history of math is ______ to me. I won't see any movie like it again.
questions.explanation: 四部電影中最不喜歡那部，最高級 the worst（最差的）。

questions.question: John's mother made him ______ the beans on the plate. They are the food he likes least.
questions.explanation: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞，made him eat...（強制使某人做某事）。

questions.question: Sharon and I are going hiking with some friends of ______, who we have known for years.
questions.explanation: double possessive：some friends of ours（我們的一些朋友），接所有格代名詞 ours。

questions.question: Please tell Sam to take his package away when he ______ over tomorrow.
questions.explanation: when 引導時間副詞子句，不用 will，以現在式 comes 代替未來。

questions.question: The gloves Grandma made by herself ______ me warm on cold days. I have used them for three years.
questions.explanation: 主詞 The gloves（複數），現在式動詞用 keep（不加 s）。

questions.question: Growing plants from seeds ______ fun for Lisa. You should look at her small vegetable garden one day.
questions.explanation: 動名詞片語 Growing plants 作主詞，視為單數，動詞用 is。

questions.question: Mark: Where's Amanda? Judy: In the bathroom. She ______ her teeth.
questions.explanation: 此刻正在刷牙，現在進行式 is brushing。

questions.question: Ted: Do Gary and Ellen have children? Alice: Well, they have a baby, but I don't remember ______ it's a boy or a girl.
questions.explanation: remember + whether（是否），間接問句中二擇一用 whether。

questions.question: Daniel: Mom, I think I have a cold. Mom: Go to bed early, ______ you'll feel worse.
questions.explanation: 「早點睡，否則你會更難受」，or 表「否則/不然」。

questions.question: When Julia entered the dining room, she saw the dishes on the dining table ______. She felt excited. There on the table were her favorites: steak, French fries, and salad.
questions.explanation: see + 受詞 + V-ing，看見菜餚正在被擺上桌，用 getting（準備就緒的過程）。

questions.question: The science test was very difficult. ______ of Ben's classmates did not finish the test in time. Of all the thirty students, only five of them did.
questions.explanation: 30 人中只有 5 人完成，大多數（25 人）沒完成，用 Most。

questions.question: To find the strange flowers ______ into medicine, you must swim across the river.
questions.explanation: 關係子句 that can be made into medicine，被動語態修飾 flowers（花被製成藥）。

questions.question: Last year at this time, I ______ abroad. It was one of the most wonderful experiences in my life.
questions.explanation: last year at this time = 去年這個時候，描述過去持續的狀態，用過去進行式。

questions.question: When Sherry and Billy go hiking, they carry their food and water with ______, so their backpacks are usually full.
questions.explanation: with them = 帶著食物和水一起，them 是受格代名詞。

questions.question: ______ at the meeting could tell there was something wrong with the new machine. They would find the problem right away.
questions.explanation: 任何人都能看出問題，肯定語境中 anyone = 任何一個人（強調普遍性）。

questions.question: There ______ six hotels near the train station. This one is the most modern and comfortable of all.
questions.explanation: There are + 複數名詞（six hotels），用 are。

questions.question: Ted: I saw Tom in the park this morning. He ______ his dog. Emma: Yes, he's usually in the park at that time.
questions.explanation: this morning（今早）那個時間點正在遛狗，用過去進行式 was walking。

questions.question: Hank is helping his new neighbor paint the walls though he ______. He is just trying to be friendly.
questions.explanation: 他不需要幫忙卻主動幫，雖然 doesn't have to（不必），但還是幫了。

questions.question: In a hurry to catch the 7:45 train, Mason ______ his cellphone in a taxi. Without the cellphone, he felt like a fish out of water.
questions.explanation: leave（遺留）+ 地點，把手機遺忘在計程車上，過去式 left。

questions.question: The poor grades have taught me a lesson. I should always prepare for the tests ______ it is too late.
questions.explanation: 在太晚之前就要準備，before it is too late = 趁還來得及。

questions.question: If Tom ______ better next year, he will go abroad with his sister to study music.
questions.explanation: 第一條件句：if + 現在式（gets），主句用 will。

questions.question: Alice: Is ______ a good idea to go to Hope Island in July? Hank: Sure. My family went there in early July last year.
questions.explanation: Is it a good idea to...? 虛主詞 it 作形式主詞。

questions.question: Sally has a new-born baby. It troubles her that her three-year-old son wants to ______ like a baby, too. She doesn't know what to do.
questions.explanation: 兒子想「被當成」嬰兒對待，被動不定詞 to be treated。

questions.question: Anna: Is it true that ______ a lot of TV makes a person stupid? Dave: Yes, it might be true.
questions.explanation: that 子句的主詞需是動名詞，watching a lot of TV（看很多電視）作主詞。

questions.question: Many stores in this town closed down last year. You know, there ______ a restaurant around the corner, but now it is gone.
questions.explanation: 以前有但現在沒有了，used to be 表「過去曾經存在」。

questions.question: Fred can't find his smartphone in the classroom or in his room. He must have left ______ on the bus.
questions.explanation: 指前面提到的特定物品（his smartphone），代名詞用 it。

questions.question: Amanda forgot ______ she had put her car keys. She has to find them right away, or she'll be late for her meeting today.
questions.explanation: 忘記把鑰匙放在哪裡，間接問句 where（地點）。

questions.question: If Mark ______ you to pick him up at the airport tomorrow evening, I will call you.
questions.explanation: if 子句用現在式代替未來，主詞 Mark 是第三人稱單數，用 needs。

questions.question: What Martha has done for Gary is helpful to his business, ______?
questions.explanation: 主句主詞是 what 子句（視為單數），be 動詞是 is，附加問句用 isn't it。

questions.question: The phone rang ______ Jenny was cooking. She had her husband answer the phone because both her hands were full.
questions.explanation: 電話在 Jenny 煮飯的「同時」響了，while 表兩事同時進行。

questions.question: Mark didn't answer Nancy's call yesterday because he didn't turn on his cellphone. He ______ for a big test at that time.
questions.explanation: at that time（當時）正在進行，用過去進行式 was preparing。

questions.question: Listening to music is a hobby ______ anywhere and at any time.
questions.explanation: 關係子句 that can be enjoyed（被動），修飾 hobby（嗜好可以在任何地方享受）。

questions.question: Irene: Excuse me. ______ is it from here to the City Museum? Jim: About two kilometers. It'll take you half an hour to walk there.
questions.explanation: 回答距離（about two kilometers），問距離用 How far。

questions.question: Carol: I've never been to Orchid Island, but I've heard things about it. Pearl: Oh, one of my friends ______ the island at least once in their life.
questions.explanation: one of my friends 主詞為 one（單數），現在完成式用 has（visited 省略）。
